import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from main import run
def blob_channel(blob):
    definitions=[]; names=[]
    for i in range(0, max(1,len(blob)), 1200):
        chunk=blob[i:i+1200]; n='Q%d'%len(names)
        definitions.append([n, 'b"%s"' % ''.join('\\x%02x' % v for v in chunk)]); names.append(n)
    doc={'seed':'s','definitions':definitions,'timeout_ms':1,'cases':[],'events':[],
         'channels':[{'name':'e','parts':[{'case':None,'data':'{{'+' + '.join(names)+'}}'}]}]}
    return run(doc)['channels'][0]
pad = b'X: ' + b'y'*(8192-3) + b'\r\n'
for n in (127,128,129):
    blob=b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b'X: y\r\n'*n + b'\r\n'
    print('fields',n, blob_channel(blob)['error'])
for n in (7,8,9):
    blob=b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + pad*n + b'\r\n'
    row=blob_channel(blob)
    print('size',n,len(blob),row['error'])
# exact 65536 block
body = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'
while len(body) + len(pad) + 2 <= 65536:
    body += pad
need = 65536 - len(body) - 2   # leave room for final CRLF
line = b'Y: ' + b'z'*(need-3-2) + b'\r\n'
body += line
assert len(body)+2 == 65536, (len(body), need)
print('exact 65536:', blob_channel(body + b'\r\n')['error'])
print('65537:', blob_channel(body + b'\r\n' + b'Z: 1\r\n\r\n')['error'])
PYEOF
